equity.level_reason: Percentages of a financial-hardship outcome are reported and described by race and Hispanic origin subgroup (Black 16.8% vs White 10.0%; Cuban 9.7% to Puerto Rican 18.8%), side by side with CIs, without disparity framing or a computed contrast.

level_alternative.reason: The outcome itself is a health-related social need (medical bill problems), so the race contrasts could be read as an SDOH report meeting level 3; but contrasts are not quantified and the SDOH is the outcome, not the exposure.

equity.equity_measurement: No referent group or computed contrast; groups compared side by side with 95% CI error bars. Total includes other race groups not shown; Hispanic total includes subgroups not shown separately.

notes: Survey weighting is not stated (NHIS estimates are normally weighted), so no weighting procedure is recorded. The outcome (family problems paying medical bills) is a financial-hardship measure, not a disease, so condition_group is empty.
